```{r setup-mascot_theme, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
character_name <- mascot::mascot_character(studio_character)$name
```

```{r mascot_theme-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_theme")
```

```{r mascot_theme-heading, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
guide_heading(paste0(character_name, "'s palettes"), "Palettes")
```

```{r mascot_theme-palettes, echo = FALSE}
guide_each_character(function(ch) guide_table(mascot::mascot_palettes(ch), wrap = "pg-palette-table"))
```

### Which mode applies

```{r mascot_theme-mode-flow, echo = FALSE}
guide_flow(
  guide_step(htmltools::tags$code('mode = "light"'), " or ", htmltools::tags$code('"dark"'), htmltools::div("always wins")),
  guide_step("page's own switch", htmltools::div(htmltools::tags$code("data-bs-theme"))),
  guide_step("Quarto", htmltools::div(htmltools::tags$code("quarto-dark"))),
  guide_step("neither found", htmltools::div("light"))
)
```

### Panels and the restore button

The panels (bubble, menu, tooltip) and the restore button can also be styled with CSS: see `?mascot_styling`.

### Brand colours from bslib

```{r mascot_theme-brand-flow, echo = FALSE}
guide_each_character(function(ch) {
  brand <- guide_brand_roles(ch)
  if (!length(brand)) {
    return(htmltools::tags$p(
      mascot::mascot_character(ch)$name,
      " has no colours that bslib's primary or secondary colour changes: a bslib theme leaves it unchanged."
    ))
  }
  guide_flow(
    guide_step(htmltools::tags$code("bs_theme(primary =)")),
    guide_step(htmltools::tags$code(brand$primary), htmltools::div("and the colours that follow it")),
    guide_gap(),
    guide_step(htmltools::tags$code("bs_theme(secondary =)")),
    guide_step(htmltools::tags$code(brand$secondary), htmltools::div("and the colours that follow it"))
  )
})
```

```{r mascot_theme-bs-theme-experimental, echo = FALSE}
# The studio quotes the help page's own sentence; the website points to the help page's section.
if (in_studio()) {
  studio_bslib_experimental()
} else {
  htmltools::tags$p(
    htmltools::tags$span(class = "badge text-bg-warning", "Experimental"),
    " Which parts of a character a bslib theme colours may change in a later release; see the experimental colour mapping section of ",
    htmltools::tags$code("?mascot_theme"),
    "."
  )
}
```

```{r mascot_theme-bs-theme-note, echo = FALSE}
guide_callout(
  htmltools::tags$strong("bs_theme(). "),
  'A bs_theme() always uses mode = "auto" and cannot be combined with palette, light, dark or css.'
)
```
